messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Hydroxyzine makes the effects of central nervous system depressants stronger.
If you take hydroxyzine with any of the following, your doctor may need to lower the dose of the other medicine.
narcotic (opioid) pain medicines
non-narcotic pain medicines
barbiturates
Hydroxyzine may increase the effects of meperidine and barbiturates when used before anesthesia.
Your doctor will adjust these doses for you individually.
Care is needed if you take other medicines.
These medicines can affect heart rhythm.
They do this by prolonging the QT interval.
These include:
heart rhythm medicines such as quinidine, procainamide, amiodarone, and sotalol
certain antipsychotics such as ziprasidone, iloperidone, clozapine, quetiapine, and chlorpromazine
certain antidepressants such as citalopram and fluoxetine
certain antibiotics such as azithromycin, erythromycin, clarithromycin, gatifloxacin, and moxifloxacin
other medicines such as pentamidine, methadone, ondansetron, and droperidol
Hydroxyzine does not affect atropine or other belladonna alkaloids.
It is not known to interfere with digitalis.
Triplet: ["Hydroxyzine", "requires dose adjustment with", "heart rhythm medicines"]

The relation 'requires dose adjustment with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug necessitates a modification of the dose of the substance or drug specified by the object entity when used concurrently.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. B. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
